main_settings.solver_profile: formal_barrier (profile A; decision 121 replaces decision 120 point (2): pypsa_eur_default is a registered non-production profile; the speed probe also uses profile A, its local reference)

acceptance.rule: decision 120: run accepted = Gurobi optimal + decision 119 (a)(b)(c) (C1 step after every solve, PRECISION.json); project solver-tolerance gates = numerical information
acceptance.tolerance_reference: L23 365x24h country differences until the batch has a disconnected run and an integrated result (decision 121: the S4N pilot via PILOT_INTEGRATED), then disconnected - integrated (BATCH_REFERENCE.json) and re-grading incl. a copy of the pilot's C1 (PILOT_PRECISION)
acceptance.stop_rule: integrated non-optimal AND C1 (a)(b)(c) not passed -> no further run; any other non-optimal run: C1 and export as usual, no retry, batch continues

reference_package.build_input_changes: BUILD_INPUT_CHANGES_<scenario>.json (why the code changes since the build cannot alter the networks)

runs: disconnected (STEPS, extra-ASEAN CO2 storage on, CO2 shipping and Lao transit kept)
disconnected_gap (GAP_DIAGNOSTIC; only if the disconnected main ends non-optimal)
run.example: GRB_LICENSE_FILE=/path/to/gurobi.lic PILOT_INTEGRATED=<pilot integrated folder> PILOT_PRECISION=<pilot PILOT_PRECISION.json> bash run_365x24h.sh --mode serial --auth '<user authorisation>'   (defaults: profile formal_barrier, runs disconnected,integrated_nze, 21,600 / 22,500 s)
run.pilot: done in S4N (integrated STEPS 365x24h, profile A, optimal, adopted under decisions 119 / 120); decision 121: the integrated run is NOT repeated, the batch runs disconnected -> NZE (-> gap diagnostic only if the disconnected main is non-optimal), serial, >= 5 min apart; B6 = this batch's disconnected - pilot integrated (PILOT_CONSISTENCY.json: same network SHA256 and profile parameters)
run.c1_step: after every solve: l23_violation_analysis.py -> VIOLATIONS.json, s4o_c1_precision.py run -> PRECISION.json / PRECISION.md (Python only, GRB_LICENSE_FILE removed); ~9 GiB / ~3 min on 365x24h (S4N measurement)
modes: lanes2 (330 s licence gaps at start and inside a lane)
withdrawn_modes: lanes3: the academic WLS licence allows at most 2 concurrent sessions, tokens kept >= 5 min (S4I K2, decision 106 a)
run.solver_profile: --solver-profile optional, default formal_barrier (profile A, decision 121); pypsa_eur_default selectable as a registered non-production profile
exports_per_run: EXPORTS.json (sizes and SHA256 incl. the C1 files)
run.run_parameters: GUROBI_TIME_LIMIT_S / WALL_CAP_S / GRACE_S / MONITOR_S / RUN_GAP_S environment variables; defaults 21,600 / 22,500 s set before the runs (decision 121: the pilot used ~80 % of 14,400 s incl. one restart, L23 NZE timed out); the speed probe only when the CPU differs from the 8470Q
run.kill_behaviour: setsid process group per solve, TERM then KILL after GRACE_S, export only after the group has exited, receipt version check (S4L-3)
run.licence: GRB_LICENSE_FILE supplied by the user on the instance

first_batch_runs: integrated (STEPS): the S4N pilot (not repeated, decision 121)

second_batch_sensitivities_registered_no.name: unified ZEP 2011 storage cost 16.05 EUR/t for every geological storage (national, intra-ASEAN receivers, extra-ASEAN 40.75)
CO2 shipping distance: single route factor 1.091 instead of the pair-specific sea path
Lao transit: nearest existing sea port and / or truck
LNG terminal expansion without cap, cost only (7,018 EUR/MW/a)
APG / AIMS plan caps per project group on top of the PyPSA-Eur limit (conservative, decision 96)
SG-VN and SG-KH DC candidates (APG other initiatives, decision 97 d)
author electrical parameters of the 19 readjusted cross-border AC lines and APG17 (decisions 98, 101 b comparison)
LA-VN grid stock of the author (1 MW split over lines 59 / 60 / 63 / 64; decision 100 comparison)
zero-capacity AC candidates with num_parallel 1.286 of template line 43 (former convention; decision 101 a comparison)
non-industrial electricity as Astar residual (former method; decision 104 comparison)
no transmission losses (S4H state; decision 105 a comparison)
AC loss proxy at the full allowed loading of one circuit (alpha 1.0; upper bound; decision 108)
AC lines lossless, DC and pipeline losses kept (lower bound; decision 108)
near-zero cleanup off (S4K / L23 state; decision 114 comparison)
biomass overflow cap at the full potential (zero slack in BN / SG / VN; S4K / L23 state; decision 115 comparison)

supersedes: S4O: successor of the S4M package f50c8850 (same networks; code, scripts and default profile changed). Earlier: the S4K package (code 56d28358, L23 first batch) is void (S4M, decisions 114-116); the S4J (bcfb2d0a), S4H (6eead675), S4G (ed6af79c) and S4F (7e09744d) packages were voided earlier; S4L built networks but packaged nothing
coalition_run_rule: decision 95 f: a coalition run non-optimal with profile A is re-run once with profile C (barrier_numericfocus2); still non-optimal -> UNVERIFIED; coalition scope decided after delivery with item 14 (decision 97 f). Note (S4O): decision 120 makes pypsa_eur_default the production profile of the coalition runs; how the decision-95 f fallback applies to it is open (S4O report)
